Title: Book an appointment tutorials — Lily Design System

# Book an appointment tutorials

The same booking screen for phones, three ways: pick your platform.

Each tutorial builds one screen of a booking app: a top bar of labelled buttons, a large heading, a line of guidance, four labelled choices and a tab bar. Each is the whole app, file by file, with a screenshot of the result.

- [Swift](https://lilydesignsystem.com/tutorials/book-appointment/swift/): iOS, with SwiftUI.
- [Kotlin](https://lilydesignsystem.com/tutorials/book-appointment/kotlin/): Android, with Jetpack Compose.
- [.NET MAUI](https://lilydesignsystem.com/tutorials/book-appointment/maui/): iOS and Android from one C# project.
